title: Admit sequence markers with clipLocal follow, ripple interval, and snap
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: SetMarkers adds, edits, and deletes sequence markers. New markers default to absolute with ripple=false and stay put when later content shifts.

A uniquely covering host can be attached explicitly (Add marker on covering clip or Anchor selected). clipLocal markers follow that host on MoveClips, overwrite, and clipboard paste; insert-move still leaves a source gap and does not split an unsplit host marker at the destination hole.

ripple=true absolute markers use the same interval crop/split/shift as captions. ripple=false later markers do not move. A marker wholly inside a closed range is dropped as a crop-to-empty and comes back on undo.
Admitted markers are snap targets. Marker labels are project metadata and are not burned into preview or export MP4.

Already-delivered leave-gap, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen ripple trim, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval crop stay unchanged.

Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source caption anchors, marker sidecar formats, or 1000 random NLE undo. Lifting a clipLocal host is refused atomically (REF_NOT_FOUND).
I-005 remains partial; I-010 remainingAcceptance unchanged; 87 counts stay 26/48/13/0; XD10 unchanged.
